# Command Staff

Sheriff McGuffey has authority over all of the diverse department divisions. All employees of the Sheriff’s Office work under her authority. The commanders in charge of the divisions and what they encompass are Majors who report directly to the Chief Deputy. The Chief Deputy in turn reports directly to the Sheriff.
